title: Genetic regulation across germline and somatic variation on the Y chromosome contributes to type 2 diabetes
description: A genetic study in over 300,000 males reveals that Y chromosome loss affects type 2 diabetes risk differently in East Asians and Europeans. Multi-omics data suggest that this may be due to impaired glucose metabolism in Y-deficient pancreatic β cells.
